test_bios_folder.py.reason: Flatpak RetroArch config/first-launch fixture; Windows deliberately bypasses _unconfigured_tree and uses different install discovery.

test_bios_readiness_sigil.py.reason: Real disc serial/region priority requires the bundled native Sigil library; portable BIOS readiness and fallback contracts run separately.

test_cemu_appimage_permissions.py.reason: Measured Windows failure: chmod does not set the POSIX owner executable bit. Exact upstream chmod assertions remain on Linux; all other Cemu discovery/audio/argv fixtures run on both OSes without executing Cemu.

test_dreamcast_sync.py.reason: Product-number-derived VMU names require Sigil disc identification; the shipped Linux shared library cannot load on Windows.

test_emulator_saves_process.py.reason: Live emulator ownership fixture executes a POSIX shell script and reads /proc PID status; needs native Windows process identity support.

test_launch_core_dir.py.reason: Windows drive paths are stripped by the existing RetroArch :/ placeholder normalization, causing redundant core directory overrides; also includes Linux /usr/lib64 discovery.

test_play_sessions_linux_boot.py.reason: Real Linux /proc boot identity is checked independently from portable synthetic recovery; Windows native boot identity remains F1-03.

test_switch_content_sigil.py.reason: Explicitly asserts the shipped Sigil library loads without an override; Windows Sigil binary is not bundled yet.

test_switch_mods.py.reason: Measured Windows ModuleNotFoundError: the 23 real mod install/recovery/removal transaction cases lazily import fcntl. Shared path conformance and missing-fcntl import/feature boundary run separately.

test_switch_nsz.py.reason: Actual compressed-container round trips require libzstd/libcrypto; both are unavailable through the current Windows native loader.

test_title_ids_sigil.py.reason: Bundled Sigil and real disc/title-ID extraction are unavailable on Windows until native dependencies are supplied.

test_mod_packages_transactions.py.reason: One real download/install/remove case enters the fcntl-backed mod transaction and fails on Windows. The other six backend mod cases stay selected; engine path and missing-fcntl contracts also run.
